title: Verisun | KEY.co
description_expanded: Outdoor living is just as splendid, with a generous private pool that invites relaxation and can be heated for year-round enjoyment. The pool area is complemented by a chic outdoor dining set and grill, perfect for alfresco entertaining. Ascend to the second floor to discover a serene master suite and three additional guest rooms, each boasting a king-sized bed and private luxurious bathroom. The top floor offers a delightful retreat for children and adults alike, featuring a cozy TV lounge, a ping-pong table for playful competition, and a guest bedroom with comfortable sleeping arrangements. This residence is more than a place to stay—it is a sophisticated sanctuary where every moment is an indulgence in luxury and comfort. Verisun Home emerges as an epitome of luxury nestled in the exclusive gated community of Santimo Beach, ideally located between the charming Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. This meticulously designed vacation haven boasts an impressive array of amenities, including five plush bedrooms plus additional bunk space, and five and a half well-appointed bathrooms. Each detail, from the lofty ceilings to the modern art adorning the walls, has been thoughtfully curated to enhance the sense of elegance and comfort. The expansive first floor features an open concept design, where the living room, dining area, and state-of-the-art kitchen merge seamlessly, adorned with dark muted pastels and sophisticated artwork.
